visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Comparator Subtracts the Wrong Way Round
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The words should be sorted shortest first, [kiwi, apple, banana], but the program prints the longest first.

solution.explanation: compare must return a negative number when the first argument should come first. a.length() - b.length() is negative when a is shorter, giving ascending order; swapping the operands reverses the order.
